P1.title: AP Biology Cellular Energetics
P1.rationale: Start with ATP so its role supports an early focus on the confusing electron transport chain. Then connect enzymes, glycolysis, the Krebs cycle, and photosynthesis before practicing each concept independently. You said Electron transport chain was difficult, so it comes earlier after its prerequisites, with extra study time where capacity allows.

sessions.title: Learn ATP and Energy Transfer
sessions.methodReason: Because you want an example before questions, a model concept map first makes ATP's links to cellular work visible in a focused session.
sessions.objective: Explain how ATP stores, releases, and transfers energy in cells.
completionEvidence: Explain ATP and energy transfer in your own words with your notes closed

sessions.title: Learn the Electron Transport Chain
sessions.methodReason: Because the electron transport chain confuses you, a concept map can trace each linked step after establishing ATP's role.
sessions.objective: Explain how electron transfer, proton pumping, and ATP synthase work together in the electron transport chain.
completionEvidence: Explain Electron transport chain in your own words with your notes closed
